name: USITC DataWeb — US trade statistics query tool
notes: The account requirement is stated in USITC's own documentation, but that documentation was not fetched here, so the claim above is limited to what the HTTP responses show.
unlock_route: Create a DataWeb account at https://dataweb.usitc.gov/ and use its interactive export; or obtain the same data from the Census trade API (keyed) instead. Not pursued: no public API documentation found.
what_is_new: Nothing collected. DataWeb is an interactive query tool with no keyless machine interface; the same underlying statistics are available from the Census trade API (keyed) and Comtrade.
